title: App and website inspection
summary: Turn REA evidence into a feature map and a testable reconstruction plan for one selected app feature.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Configured target ID
inputs.description: An operator-registered website or JavaScript application target.

inputs.label: Feature to investigate
inputs.description: One concrete behavior to explain or rebuild.

stages.title: Collect evidence
stages.description: Run the matching installed recipe and verify retained evidence and coverage.

stages.title: Map the feature
stages.description: Separate direct observations, static candidates and unanswered behavior questions.

stages.title: Prepare a reconstruction
stages.description: Define inputs, outputs, states and behavior checks with evidence references.
